cadence_bandwidth_study_result.description: Read the fixed two-grid bandwidth study for the preserved admitted native AC operation using registered bandwidth IDs and its original analog contract hash. No simulation, caller frequency/grid/path/expression, raw vectors or target evaluation.
cadence_bandwidth_study_result.name: cadence_bandwidth_study_result

cadence_evaluate_amplifier_specification.description: Evaluate registered goals against exact admitted amplifier sweep point facts using source/catalog digests and the existing comparator. Absent goal remains NOT_EVALUATED. Exact conditions only; no caller target/value/path/script or new execution.
cadence_evaluate_amplifier_specification.name: cadence_evaluate_amplifier_specifications

cadence_offset_study_result.description: Read fixed nominal open-loop input-nulling diagnostics using the registered offset contract hash and preserved admitted DC operation. Applied Vp−Vm at Vop−Vom=0; five fixed scalar receipts, local bracket and refinement diagnostics. Numerical residual is consistent with zero, not physical precision. Generic offset remains UNQUALIFIED. No simulation, caller path/range/expression or goal evaluation.
cadence_offset_study_result.name: cadence_offset_study_result
